items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025

ctx.x: Very odd. Okay. My half a question: do you think it was odd that Stan Kenton used mellophones instead of French horns?

I think – I never thought about it much one way or the other, but I think he wanted that direct sound. He didn’t want the more non-directional. Because the thing with the horn, it’s true if there’s a big band and there’s even a couple of horns if it’s soft it’ll work. Like Claude Thornhill. But if it’s brassy and loud and trumpets and loud trombones and if he wanted that extra thing the mellophones I guess make more sense.
